description: Schema for benchmarks/doctoral_82/datasets.csv. The importer at scripts/import_doctoral_benchmark_datasets.py validates every row against this contract.

columns.name: dataset_id
columns.description: Stable identifier; matches doe_xgb.datasets.REGISTRY when an entry exists. Snake_case.

columns.name: openml_id
columns.description: OpenML data id when applicable. Must be unique across the registry.

columns.name: has_categorical
columns.description: True when at least one categorical feature is present in the canonical schema.

columns.name: class_imbalance_ratio
columns.description: max(class_count) / min(class_count). Optional; computed by the loader on first fetch.

columns.name: license
columns.description: Free-form license note (CC BY 4.0, GPL, etc.).

columns.name: include
columns.description: Whether the dataset is part of the active doctoral panel.

columns.name: reason
columns.description: Why the dataset was included or excluded.

columns.name: loader_status
columns.description: registered = doe_xgb.datasets.REGISTRY has it; pending = needs work; broken = blocked.

validation_rules: task_type='multiclass' implies n_classes IS NULL OR n_classes >= 3.
openml_id values must be unique when set.
